title: AI agents system #ai #automation #tools
description:
Multi-agent systems are becoming a major trend in AI workflows.

Ruflow (formerly Claude Flow) connects multiple agents into one coordinated system.

How it works:

— Separate agents handle different tasks (planning, coding, testing, security)
— All agents run in parallel
— Shared memory allows continuous improvement across runs

Key benefits:

— Faster execution through parallel workflows
— Smarter outputs via collaboration between agents
— Optimized costs by routing tasks to the most efficient models

Built on top of Claude, the system expands what a single AI can do by turning it into a coordinated network.

The broader shift:

AI is moving from single assistants to full systems of agents working together.
